content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Sells lab instruments, consumables and sample services to the same pharma, biotech and research lab customers."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Makes research instruments, reagents and clinical diagnostic kits sold to the same labs and pharma customers."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Sells research reagents, antibodies, instruments and diagnostic tests to the same life science and clinical lab customers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Makes and licenses generic prescription drugs, a different business from lab tools, reagents and diagnostics."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Mainly sells biodefense vaccines and antidotes to governments, a different customer and product base."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes blood collection and processing devices for blood centers and hospitals, not lab instruments or reagents."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures medical device components and devices for device OEMs, not lab tools or diagnostics."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Sells quality control instruments, indicators and sample preparation equipment to pharma and lab customers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Sells medical and dental products and health information software to providers, a different business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Provides contract sterilization and product testing for device makers, not lab tools or reagents."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Sells sterilizers and surgical equipment to hospitals and dentists, differing from lab instruments and reagents."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Distributes and calibrates industrial test instruments across many industries, not life science tools or diagnostics."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Sells industrial coding printers and water quality instruments, a different business from life science tools."}]}
